result.notes: Lark (Larksuite) Open Platform exposes a broad REST API (IM, Contact, Drive/Docs, Calendar, Approval, Attendance, Bitable, etc.) under open.larksuite.com/open-apis. Developers self-register a free enterprise account via the 免费试用 (free trial) flow and become the default admin, then create a custom (self-built) app in the developer console to get app_id/app_secret credentials — no separate app review needed for building/using an app within your own tenant. Auth uses app_id/app_secret (api_key-like) to mint tenant_access_token/app_access_token, or a standard OAuth2 authorization-code flow to mint user_access_token; all tokens are then sent as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header. Publishing an app to the public marketplace for other tenants would require additional admin/marketplace review, but that is not required to build and use an agent toolkit against your own tenant. An official vendor-published MCP server exists at larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp. Confidence is moderated by relying on Chinese-language doc pages via fetch summarization rather than direct verbatim inspection of English docs.
result.one_liner: Lark (Larksuite) is an all-in-one workplace communication and collaboration suite (chat, docs, calendar, approvals) with an extensive Open Platform REST API.
